newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker Maritime gets new structure.
newsitem.headline: Aker Maritime gets new structure.

text.p: Norwegian offshore services group Aker Maritime ASA on Friday announced a new organisational structure under which the company would concentrate on five main areas.
Those areas were identified as Large Projects in Norway, Products, USA, Britain as well as Operations, Maintenance and Modifications.
Each unit will have an independent management with responsibility for further development and expansion, a statement said.

Bjoern Rune Gjelsten, who is president and chief executive officer of industrial group Aker RGI ASA, Aker Maritime's largest shareholder, will be new chairman, replacing Jan Wennesland, the statement said.
Wennesland will head the Products unit under the plan, which was approved by the board on Thursday.
Daily Aftenposten said Gjelsten was expected to pursue an aggressive policy for Aker Maritime with large acquisitions in order to double the company's turnover.
